name: Women's Aviator Shirt Uniform cadet officer epaulet sleeve, left shoulder, top-down (blank grade)
size_basis: Length and width of the slide-on sleeve the garment overlay draws on the strap (the strap polygon cut short of its button); colour and CAP lettering placement as the Class B top-down sleeves. Fig 4.16 gives about 0.9 x 5.7 in at the pocket scale; the regulation states no dimension.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); rank_slot holds the largest regular-size grade form; rank_rule_point is the 5/8 in from the outer end point for single forms
documented: grade insignia centred 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)
